longBusinessSummary: Primaris Real Estate Investment Trust is Canada's only enclosed shopping Centre focused REIT, with ownership interests in leading enclosed shopping centres located in growing Canadian markets. The proforma portfolio totals 15.3 million square feet, valued at approximately 5.6 billion dollars at Primaris' share. Economies of scale are achieved through its fully internal, vertically integrated, full-service national management platform. Primaris is very well-capitalized and is exceptionally well positioned to take advantage of market opportunities at an extraordinary moment in the evolution of the Canadian retail property landscape. Primaris Real Estate Investment Trust was incorporated in 2021 in Ontario, Canada.
